states.noInvoicesDescription: Pick another range or issue your first invoice — the statement is built from invoices, not from work entries.

document.title: Sales invoice register
document.subtitle: Service period, buyer and place of work

placeholders.noPeriod: No service period on the invoice

notes.method: The statement covers invoices issued within the given period. Amounts come from the invoices; net and VAT add up to the gross amount even for documents without a separate tax breakdown.
notes.locations: The place of work comes from the project address and the work recorded for this buyer within the invoice service period. Working days on an invoice row count distinct days — the same day across two projects counts once.
notes.currencies: Each currency is totalled separately. Amounts are not converted.
notes.missingPeriod: Invoices without a recorded service period
notes.missingLocation: Invoices without recorded work in the service period
